name: Thunder Pair
description: Beat two quick fists into the target each carrying its own small thunderhead of qi.

name: Cloudbank Guard
description: Heap a long bank of cloud qi before the body so that blows sink into it and lose their edge.

name: Twin Shift
description: Shift weight from one cloud to the other in a quick double step that dodges a straight attack.

name: Pair Flash
description: Flash two bolts from the twin clouds at once so that the target cannot dodge both.

name: Crossed Peal
description: Cross the two peals of thunder in front of the body to throw a strike off and stun the striker.

name: Echo Veil
description: Hang a veil of rolling thunder qi that answers each blow with a dull boom and a weaker return.

name: Heavy Pair
description: Drop both thunderheads onto the target's shoulders so that he is struck and pinned beneath the weight.

name: Twin Thunderheads
description: Build two cloud summits over the field and bring them down in a wide paired blow.

name: Thunderhead Collision
description: Drive two great thunderheads together over the target so that the clash falls as one wide and ruinous strike.

name: Squall Pair
description: Strike with one hand carrying the squall and the other following with its slow rain.

name: Rainband Guard
description: Wind a belt of rain qi about the waist and arms that spreads a blow along its length.

name: Pair Dash
description: Dash two quick strides on a squall at the back and a damp current under the feet.

name: Twin Needle
description: Throw two needles of rain qi that cross in the air and strike the target from both sides.

name: Sweeping Pair
description: Swing both arms in a broad sweep that flings squall and rain across the whole front.

name: Rain Lock
description: Pour a heavy rain on the opponent's legs that thickens into a weight that holds him in place.

name: Squall Parry
description: Snap a short hard squall against an incoming limb to turn it aside.

name: Drenching Squall
description: Keep a squall and a steady pour on the foes until their limbs sag and their guard drops.

name: Rain Sheath
description: Draw a sheath of mending rain about an ally that turns blows and closes small wounds beneath it.

name: Twin Deluge
description: Pour a squall and a river of rain onto the field in one deluge that crushes and holds all within.

name: Thunder Fist
description: Punch with the whole body full of storm qi so that it spills out through the fist on contact.

name: Brimful Ward
description: Fill the chest with qi to its brim so that blows are held at the surface of the body.

name: Brim Step
description: Tip the weight and let the stored qi spill forward to carry the body a pace.

name: Pooled Cast
description: Gather a pool of rain qi in the palm and cast it flat across the opponent's chest.

name: Ripple Gauge
description: Judge how full a person's own qi is by how it ripples against the user's.

name: Overflow Strike
description: Let the stored storm brim over the fist at the moment of impact in one heavy surge.

name: Cupped Squall
description: Cup a held squall in both hands before the body so that it drinks the next hit whole.

name: Sluice Cleanse
description: Open a gate of rain qi through an ally's body to flush out poison and taint.

name: Brimming Tempest
description: Raise a full tempest from the stored qi and let it break over everything the user can see.

name: Thunder Mantle
description: Spread the stored storm as a mantle over the user and an ally that guards them and feeds their strength.

name: Tempest Overflow
description: Drink the force of the enemy's strikes into the body until it brims and release it all as a tempest.

name: Hawkflash Fist
description: Dart a fist forward with a flash of lightning qi along the knuckles.

name: Pinion Screen
description: Hold both arms out in a screen of crackling qi shaped like a raptor's wings.

name: Swoop Dash
description: Lunge low in a long swooping step that ends well inside the opponent's reach.

name: Hawk Bolt
description: Hurl a fast thin bolt from above the shoulder that strikes at the throat or the wrist.

name: Plunge Cry
description: Cry out a high thin note as thunder qi shakes the opponent's sense of where the blow will fall.

name: Glide Parry
description: Glide along an attacking arm on a thin sheet of lightning and send the blow past.

name: Stoop Lightning
description: Dive a single heavy bolt from high above that pierces the guard and the body behind it.

name: Skyward Rise
description: Leap on a column of rising qi that carries the body well clear and shields its legs.

name: Lightning Stoop
description: Vanish in a flash of lightning and reappear high above the foe to fall on him with the full charge.

name: Cerulean Palm
description: Strike with a palm of clear blue qi that rings like a struck bell on the target.

name: Azure Screen
description: Stretch a thin screen of bright qi before the body that scatters light blows and weak bolts.

name: Sky Step
description: Bound from the ground on a short rising wind that carries the body above a low sweep.

name: Bluebolt Cast
description: Cast a blue-white bolt from the fingers that leaps out of a clear sky.

name: Azure Sense
description: Open the senses to the clear air above and feel who disturbs it from afar.

name: Azure Lash
description: Lash a whip of blue lightning across the opponent's arms to snap his hold and his aim.

name: Clearsky Cleanse
description: Brush a clear dry wind over an ally to lift fever and fog and curse-taint from the body.

name: Cloudless Guard
description: Brace for a hit with a bare calm guard and turn it with one quick spark of qi.

name: Tempest Rush
description: Rush across the field on a tempest gathered at the back that arrives with the user.

name: Azure Thunder
description: Call thunder out of the clear air above the target in one blow that breaks outward on landing.

name: Storm Canopy
description: Raise a canopy of weather that covers the user and the allies close by and sheds blows from above.

name: Tempest Crown
description: Settle a crown of tempest over the field in a single great gathering that strikes and presses down.

name: Plateau Fist
description: Punch level and flat from a square stance with a broad low squall rolling behind the fist.

name: Levelled Cover
description: Hold a level sheet of qi across the front that takes a blow without tilting.

name: Unhurried Pace
description: Step square and unhurried across open ground on a flat push of wind that never stumbles.

name: Flat Squall
description: Throw a flat squall low along the ground that knocks down all who stand in its path.

name: Levelling Rain
description: Drop a heavy even rain on the foe that presses the whole body down to one level.

name: Steady Draft
description: Hold a steady draft across the body so that an incoming strike slips off to the side.

name: Plateau Thunder
description: Stamp down so that a flat sheet of thunder runs through the ground and bursts under the target.

name: Broad Canopy
description: Spread a broad even canopy of storm over the user and allies that guards them and steadies their arms.

name: Plateau Tempest
description: Sweep a whole tempest level across the open ground and press everything on it flat beneath its weight.

name: Stonefast Fist
description: Throw a fist from a stance sunk deep into the ground so the blow is held by the earth.

name: Mooring Guard
description: Sink the stance and run storm qi down the legs so that no blow can drive the user back.

name: Pledge Slide
description: Slide a short pace on the sworn wind without lifting the weight from the anchoring foot.

name: Anchor Spark
description: Throw a spark of lightning that is rooted to the user and snaps back to the hand.

name: Oath Peal
description: Speak the oath as a peal of thunder that shakes the footing of those who would break it.

name: Anchor Chain
description: Cast a chain of lightning qi from the anchoring leg that wraps the target and holds him.

name: Anchor Parry
description: Hold the anchor firm and swing the free arm to turn a blow away with a spark.

name: Anchor Thunder
description: Draw thunder up the anchoring leg and drive it through the fist in a single heavy blow.

name: Oathkeeper Ward
description: Shield a sworn ally under the user's anchor and let the steadying storm close his wounds.

name: Oath Thunderfall
description: Call the sworn thunder down on one named oath-breaker so that it strikes through all his defenses and holds him.

name: Windward Fist
description: Punch into the face of the wind with the whole of its pressure driving the blow.

name: Stillair Guard
description: Turn the shoulder to the wind and let a pocket of still air form behind it.

name: Beat Step
description: Beat forward against the wind in short hard steps that gain ground by degrees.

name: Windward Cast
description: Cast a bolt directly into the wind where its force is doubled by the headlong air.

name: Thunderhead Reading
description: Feel the gusts shift across the skin to learn how many move and how they stand.

name: Windward Lash
description: Whip a hard head-on gust across the opponent's guard to break his stance and his rhythm.

name: Headwind Check
description: Raise a headwind against the foe that slows every step and every swing he tries to make.

name: Tail Draft
description: Turn about and ride a tail draft that hurls the user away from a losing exchange.

name: Brisk Cleanse
description: Blow a brisk clean wind through an ally to strip off poison and stale taint.

name: Windward Tempest
description: Gather a tempest against the wind and let it burst forward in a broad blow that scours the front.

name: Rebuff Gust
description: Meet a thrown technique with a counter gust that turns it round and sends it home.

name: Rallying Wind
description: Raise a rallying wind at the backs of allies that lifts their strength and spirit.

name: Storm Eye Reckoning
description: Fix the whole tempest on one chosen foe and drive its core through him while its weight holds him still.

name: Bearing Palm
description: Strike along a bearing fixed in the squall so the palm lands exactly where it was aimed.

name: Mark Guard
description: Draw a firm line of qi across the front and let the squall pile against it.

name: Tempest Heading
description: Step along a bearing taken by feel so the body arrives at one chosen point.

name: Squall Mark
description: Flick a mark of squall qi onto the target that the next strike will home on.

name: Squall Lock
description: Close the squall round the marked limb so that it cannot swing free of its bearing.

name: Bearing Shift
description: Shift the line of the body off a blow while the feet hold to their bearing on the target.

name: Mark Burst
description: Burst the mark on the target with a strike so its stored squall breaks inside him.

name: True Squall
description: Drive a narrow squall along the held bearing to pierce a guard that would turn any wider blow.

name: Bearing Sweep
description: Spread the bearings out over the field to feel each foe's place and shield the user against them.

name: Squall Return
description: Take the force of a striking technique into the squall and cast it back along the same bearing.

name: Pledge Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a sworn word and the sworn wind behind it.

name: Pledge Guard
description: Stand on a pledge to hold and let the pledged wind harden into a guard.

name: Pledge Step
description: Take a pledged step that the wind finishes so the body arrives where it was sworn to.

name: Sworn Bolt
description: Loose a small bolt that keeps to its promised line even through a crosswind.

name: Sworn Weight
description: Feel the weight of a sworn oath on a person through the wind that passes round him.

name: Pledge Surge
description: Surge forward on the pledge so that the strike lands and the wind breaks outward after it.

name: Binding Oath
description: Speak a binding word as the wind turns and seal the foe's qi for the length of a breath.

name: Vow Cleanse
description: Wash an ally in the sworn wind to strip off poison and the sting of a broken oath.

name: Sworn Cyclone
description: Keep a cyclone turning round the user at the caller's word to cut and batter the near foes.

name: Oath Canopy
description: Spread a canopy of sworn storm over the allies so that it shields them and hardens their resolve.

name: Tempest Vow
description: Loose the full sworn tempest at the caller's word so that it falls on the foes and spares the allies.
